title: Ge: internal strain, clamped versus relaxed shear and the Raman mode (PBE, 6 GPa)

decision_points.fork: Electronic state of PBE Ge at its own zero-pressure lattice parameter
decision_points.wrong_choice: Read the 'gap' from the band edges of the mesh: a shifted mesh never contains Gamma and reports a small positive gap; a Gamma-containing mesh with fixed occupations reports HOMO = LUMO
decision_points.consequence: Misses that the s-like Gamma2' level lies below the p-like Gamma25' triplet (band-inverted semimetal), which is why the internal-strain response is not converged at zero pressure and why fixed occupations on Gamma meshes fill a degenerate level

decision_points.kind: convergence that matters only for some quantities
decision_points.fork: Cutoff for pressures (Pulay stress) and the reference lattice parameters
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use a cutoff at which total energies look converged (35 Ry) for the pressure route, or strain about the experimental lattice parameter
decision_points.consequence: The stress of the 3d-in-valence ultrasoft file carries a Pulay error of about -1.4 GPa at 35 Ry (-0.15 GPa at 45 Ry; energies look converged at 35 Ry): a0 and a(6 GPa) come out 0.041 and 0.031 A too small, and every 6 GPa quantity is then computed at the wrong volume (omega +5 cm^-1)
Pressure at fixed a +0.3 to +0.5 GPa: a0 +0.009 A and a(6 GPa) +0.010 A; optical force constant +3.7 % (omega +5.7 cm^-1), Lambda +3 %

decision_points.kind: discovered evidence (k sampling of a response concentrated at Gamma)
decision_points.fork: Brillouin-zone mesh for the internal-strain force
decision_points.wrong_choice: The usual offset (shifted) Monkhorst-Pack mesh for a diamond-structure semiconductor, converged on the energy, pressure or even the clamped shear stress
decision_points.consequence: The internal-strain force Lambda comes out ~9 % too small at 8x8x8 (still ~2 % at 12x12x12): zeta ~9 % low and the relaxed C44 ~12 % high; visible only by converging the force itself or by the Maxwell relation Omega dsigma_yz/du_x = Lambda

decision_points.fork: Occupations for a small-gap semiconductor that is a semimetal at zero pressure
decision_points.wrong_choice: Keep Marzari-Vanderbilt smearing of 0.01-0.02 Ry (natural after finding the zero-pressure semimetal)
decision_points.consequence: Partial occupation across the 0.3 eV direct gap softens the optical force constant by ~3-4 %: Raman frequency ~5 cm^-1 low

decision_points.fork: What the relaxed-ion shear constant is and whether a relaxation actually relaxed
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report the clamped stress, or relax at a 0.2 % shear with the default 1e-3 Ry/bohr threshold (the initial force is already below it, so the 'converged' relaxation never moves)
decision_points.consequence: C44 relaxed 48 % too high (95.5 instead of 64.6 GPa) and zeta = 0, i.e. 'internal relaxation is negligible'; the 0.2 % relaxation reports convergence after one ionic step because the initial force (8e-4 Ry/bohr) is already below the threshold

decision_points.fork: Frozen-phonon displacement for the Raman force constant
decision_points.wrong_choice: A single displacement along [111] (the cubic xyz term of the Td site makes the force quadratic in u)
decision_points.consequence: The force is quadratic in a one-sided [111] displacement: omega -7.6 cm^-1 for u = 0.02(1,1,1) A and -20 cm^-1 for 0.05(1,1,1) A (+19 cm^-1 with the opposite sign); +- pairs or a cube-axis displacement are exact to 0.1 cm^-1

decision_points.fork: Elastic constants of the pressurized crystal from energies or stresses
decision_points.wrong_choice: Fit the energy of the sheared cell without removing the work of the 6 GPa pre-stress on the second-order volume change (or one-sided normal strains)
decision_points.consequence: Clamped C44 ~3 % high; one-sided 2 % normal strain biases C11/C12 through the third-order constants

decision_points.fork: Reduced mass and engineering shear strain
decision_points.wrong_choice: Atomic mass instead of M/2 for the relative coordinate; tensor eps_yz used as the Voigt shear
decision_points.consequence: omega / sqrt(2); C44 and zeta x2

decision_points.kind: regime judgement (where a finite difference stops being local)
decision_points.fork: Volume step for the Raman Grueneisen parameter at 6 GPa
decision_points.wrong_choice: The customary +-1 % in the lattice parameter
decision_points.consequence: On the expanded side the direct gap at Gamma nearly closes (0.31 eV at a(6 GPa), 0.03 eV at +1 % in a) and the optical force constant softens anomalously; +-1 % gives gamma = 1.43 (2.43 on a Gamma-centred 8x8x8 mesh) instead of the local 1.03, visible only by comparing compression- and expansion-side steps

length_estimate.tool_calls: 40-70 (15-30 evaluations: pressures at 2-3 cutoffs, Gamma band ordering, k/occupation ladders of the internal-strain force and optical force constant, clamped/relaxed shear, normal strains, two volumes; each 0.2-3 minute job followed by 1-3 polls)

runtime_dependencies: Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 pw.x and OpenMPI from the runtime image (lab only)
numpy 1.21.5 from the runtime image (lab charge counter, oracle)

notes: Deviation from the candidate design (accepted by the coordinator): PBE Ge (GBRV, no spin-orbit coupling) is a band-inverted semimetal at its own zero-pressure lattice parameter (E(Gamma2')-E(Gamma25') = -0.44 eV), and there the internal-strain force does not converge with any mesh the lab offers (shifted k6-k12: 0.180/0.225/0.250/0.263 Ry/bohr; Gamma-centred 0.29-0.35), so zeta and the relaxed C44 are not uniquely recoverable at zero pressure. The shear/Raman analysis is therefore graded at 6 GPa (a = 5.601 A), where the direct gap at Gamma is open (+0.31 eV) and Gamma-centred meshes converge (Lambda 0.3978/0.3997/0.4004/0.4008 at k8/k10/k12/k16). The zero-pressure lattice parameter and the signed Gamma gap remain graded. The candidate's hidden validation SCFs were dropped: every graded number is derived from several agent-bought calculations. Elastic constants under pressure are graded as Cauchy stress-strain coefficients; the experimental C/zeta/omega are rubric context only.
